about: Suspension-bridge towers added to the scene as plain steel legs (pixelphilly.bridges.tower_legs, scripts/05_build_scene.py with "bridge_towers": true). The decks' LiDAR shapes are dropped (bridges.drop_deck_parts) and the 2024 aerial sees each tower only from above, so without these the model drew the Ben Franklin with one tower and the Walt Whitman with none (Nov. 9 redraw, output/review/bridges/nj/gpu_test/final_bfb.jpg, final_wwb.jpg). Each tower's outline is its OSM way (data/raw/<area>_bridge_towers.json, scripts/04q_fetch_bridge_towers.py, ODbL): a strip across the deck. It is drawn as two square legs, one at each end of the strip, each as wide as the strip; no source gives the leg dimensions, so the leg size is an estimate. Heights are published figures. Colors are approximate paint colors (estimates, not measured values). min_leg_m (Walt Whitman, 5.0 m, an estimate in line with the Ben Franklin strips' 5.2-6.1 m) widens legs on strips thinner than that, centered on the strip; the 3.3 m OSM strips would draw as needles.
